answer_1.quote: In the first step, it generates the charge rationale and penalty rationale respectively according to the fact description.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy of rationale generation. To evaluate the performance of the generation, we adopt ROUGE and BLEU as the metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to better analyze the quality of the generated rationales. First, we randomly sample 500 test cases, for each case, we present generated rationales from each method and the corresponding predicted judgment of RLJP(CNN) with the ground truth to 5 human annotators with legal backgrounds.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to give a score on the consistency of the generated rationales and the fluency of the generated rationales.
